title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: From engineering cardboard canoes to sliding through the student center at Christmas, Cedarville's traditions blend high energy with a tight-knit campus culture.

cards.title: Cardboard Canoe Race
cards.subtitle: A Homecoming Engineering Rite of Passage
cards.notes: Watch freshman engineering students attempt to paddle across Cedar Lake in boats made only of cardboard and packaging tape.
cards.short_summary: A high-stakes Homecoming tradition where freshman engineering students race handmade cardboard boats across the campus lake.
cards.evidence_claim: The cardboard canoe race is an annual homecoming weekend tradition for first-year engineering students that debuted in 1993.
cards.source_title: First-Year Engineers Race Cardboard Canoes | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Held annually on the Friday of Homecoming weekend at Cedar Lake.

cards.title: Elliv
cards.subtitle: The Grand Finale Talent Showcase
cards.notes: Attend this massive student-run talent show featuring musical acts, comedy, and a highly competitive costume contest.
cards.short_summary: Cedarville's largest student-run event, 'Elliv' (Ville spelled backward), serves as a high-energy end-of-year talent and awards showcase.
cards.evidence_claim: Elliv is a student-run tradition featuring musical performances, skits, comedy, and a costume competition held every spring.
cards.source_title: Elliv 2025: Cedarville's Grand Finale Event Set to Make History
cards.access_notes: Typically held in late April in the Jeremiah Chapel of the Dixon Ministry Center.

cards.title: The Jacket Jaunt
cards.subtitle: The Official Welcome Home Walk
cards.notes: Join the freshman class as they circle Cedar Lake to be officially declared Yellow Jackets by the University President.
cards.short_summary: A foundational Getting Started tradition where new students walk around the lake while being cheered on by the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jacket Jaunt is a tradition where freshmen circle the lake together to be officially welcomed into the Cedarville family.
cards.source_title: Getting Started Weekend - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Occurs on Saturday evening during Getting Started Weekend in August.

cards.title: Painting The Rock
cards.subtitle: Campus Message Board in Stone
cards.notes: Check out the latest layer of spray paint on this landmark, used for everything from birthday wishes to event promos.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing tradition where students spray-paint a large rock near the student center to announce events or celebrate friends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rock is a landmark between the Stevens Student Center and Health Sciences Center that students have painted for years.
cards.source_title: Campus Visit Essentials - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors between the Stevens Student Center and the Health Sciences Center.

cards.title: The Campus Christmas Slide
cards.subtitle: Indoor Winter Fun in the SSC
cards.notes: Take a ride down the giant indoor slide installed in the student center specifically for the annual Campus Christmas event.
cards.short_summary: A highlight of the Campus Christmas celebration where a massive slide is constructed inside the Stevens Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Christmas features a giant slide in the Stevens Student Center (SSC) along with cookie decorating and karaoke.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions and Events | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Available during the Campus Christmas event in early December.

cards.title: Deck the Halls
cards.subtitle: Immersive Dorm Decorating Contest
cards.notes: Tour the residence halls to see elaborate themed decorations and student skits during this competitive holiday tradition.
cards.short_summary: A high-effort competition where residence halls transform their hallways into themed walkthrough experiences for the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Deck the Halls is an event where residence halls pick themes and decorate units with actors performing stories for tours.
cards.source_title: Campus Christmas 2022 - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community on a designated Friday night in December.

cards.title: Moonlight Madness
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Basketball Kickoff
cards.notes: Get a first look at the Yellow Jacket basketball teams during this high-energy late-night event in the Callan Athletic Center.
cards.short_summary: An annual athletic tradition that introduces the men's and women's basketball teams with player intros and skills contests.
cards.evidence_claim: Moonlight Madness is an annual event in the Callan Athletic Center that highlights the basketball teams to kick off the season.
cards.source_title: Moonlight Madness kicks off hoops season - Cedarville University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Held late at night, typically in late October or early November.

cards.title: Meeting at The Seal
cards.subtitle: The Campus Crossroads
cards.notes: Use this life-size university seal in the Dixon Ministry Center as your primary landmark for meeting up with friends.
cards.short_summary: A common social practice where students use the official university seal display as a central meeting point before chapel or events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Seal is a life-size display located outside the Jeremiah Chapel in the Dixon Ministry Center used as a meet-up location.
cards.source_title: Cedarville University Slang Dictionary - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Located in the Alumni Hall of the Dixon Ministry Center.

cards.title: The Hob Line
cards.subtitle: The Daily Dining Hall Ritual
cards.notes: Join the longest line in the dining hall for a custom burrito or bowl at 'The Hob,' Cedarville's favorite food station.
cards.short_summary: A daily student ritual involving the 'Habanero' line in the dining hall, universally known by its shorthand nickname.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hob is a food line in the dining hall (short for habanero) that is typically the longest and favorite line for students.
cards.source_title: Cedarville University Slang Dictionary - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Stevens Student Center dining area.

cards.title: ALT Nights
cards.subtitle: Alternative Friday Entertainment
cards.notes: Enjoy themed Friday night events like 'Cedarville's Got Talent' or dodgeball tournaments designed as on-campus alternatives.
cards.short_summary: A series of five major Friday night events per year hosted by the Campus Activity Board to build community through unique activities.
cards.evidence_claim: ALT Nights are free events aimed at building campus community through activities like food trucks, movies, and tournaments.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions and Events | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Held five times per year on designated Friday nights at various campus locations.
